outlook.statement: The management is focusing on improving profitability in a sustainable manner. The Company remains committed to its long-term vision of delivering sustainable, innovative solutions to meet evolving industrial and environmental needs, positioning itself to rebound as conditions stabilize.

Outlook remains positive driven by strong fundamentals in Indian caustic soda industry and company's leadership in electrochemical technologies. Industry projected to grow at CAGR of ~8% from FY 2024-25 to FY 2029-30. Company well-positioned to leverage niche capabilities in membrane recoating and cathodic protection systems, expanding presence across South East Asia. Optimistic about growth prospects in FY 2026-27.
